{{Quote|There are many things that can break a man but nothing more than the Rebellion's disregard for innocent life.|Var Narek|<ref name="OAA" />}}
The '''Bombing of Rialla Way''' was a massacre perpetrated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the civilians of [[Rialla Way]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. The event was masterminded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Malau Jocaos]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] in order to blame the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and make [[Var Narek]] an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]].

==Bombing==
When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Malau Jocaos]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] suspected that his former schoolmate [[Var Narek]] had joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], he devised a plan to bring him into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] service. He orchestrated an aerial bombardment which destroyed a number of Imperial buildings and civilian shops where the Rebels had supposedly been hiding, causing the deaths of Var Narek's younger [[Aleos Narek|brother]] and [[Aleos Narek's wife|all]] [[Aleos Narek's daughter|his]] [[Aleos Narek's son|family]]. The bombing was quickly blamed on the Rebels, whose actions had led to the deaths of people who had nothing to do with the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]].<ref name="OAA" />

==Aftermath==
The loss of his young niece and nephew completely broke Var Narek's spirit, and he decided to side with the Imperials to destroy the Rebel Alliance. He sought out his old friend from his days at school, Malau Jocaos, now an officer in the Imperial Intelligence, and became a traitor to the Alliance.<ref name="OAA" />

Var Narek was then sent to the [[Arda Base|Rebel base]] on [[Arda I]], posing as just another person in the fight for freedom, where he gathered intelligence for months in preparation of an [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|attack]]. Several days after the onslaught, Rebel agent [[Haril Zense]] determined that the Imperials had masterminded the bombing to infiltrate an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="OAA" />
